rca of the issue: Root cause of silent Download pack failure in production: NoticeDetailE.jsx previously built packUrl as `${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/v1/notices/{ref}/pack`. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is baked at build time, so the production bundle pointed at the preview host, triggering CORS from pmcmanagers.com. Fix: switch to relative `/api/v1/...` path so axios baseURL resolves same-origin on prod and preview-host on preview. Verified via network tab — pack request hits same origin and returns application/zip.
